text:
sanjay: quick smoke check on the new 'pegasus-11b' bring-up. ran int8 and int4 sweeps overnight, econ numbers attached. can we decide a safe initial routing for GTN?

eval-bot: automated summary from nightly run (2026-03-19 23:48 UTC)
- workloads: chat (conversational), longform QA, code-completion microbench
- models: peg-11b-int8, peg-11b-int4, ref-13b-int8 (prod baseline)
- perf: peg-11b-int8 p95=210ms (chat, seq=128), int4 p95=190ms
- throughput: int8 420 tok/s, int4 760 tok/s (single A100-like GPU, batch=8)
- unit cost (est): ref-13b-int8 = $105 / 1M tokens, peg-11b-int8 = $78 / 1M, peg-11b-int4 = $36 / 1M
- quality (task-aggregate): ref-13b-int8 = 0.812, peg-11b-int8 = 0.800 (-1.5%), peg-11b-int4 = 0.768 (-5.3%)
- longform QA R@5: ref-13b-int8 0.86, peg-11b-int8 0.84, peg-11b-int4 0.78
- regression flags: peg-11b-int4 shows repeat rate +6% on long prompts; hallucination score up 0.04

elaine: thanks. can you paste the eval-bot slice that triggered the regression flag?

eval-bot: ```
slice: longform_qa > 1024 tokens
metrics:
  r_at_5: ref-13b-int8=0.86, peg-11b-int8=0.84, peg-11b-int4=0.78
  repeat_rate: ref=0.05, peg-11b-int8=0.06, peg-11b-int4=0.11
notes: int4 worst on multi-span extraction; likely kv-cache precision loss or attention kernel quant error
```

meera: int4 looks attractive on token econ but that repeat/hallucination delta is material for GTN use-cases (search/qa). product will push back if longform degrades.

dana: agree. from rollout/ops POV we could:
- canonical route: peg-11b-int8 for chat and longform QA
- cheap route: peg-11b-int4 behind an opt-in flag for low-risk short-chat traffic (<256 tokens)
- Canary: start 5% traffic with A/B monitors (fidelity, repeat_rate, latency)

ciara: product ask: what is delta in end-to-end latency for interactive chat (with streaming) between ref-13b-int8 and peg-11b-int8? need to know user-perceived token latency.

meera: streaming token TOU was measured: ref-13b-int8 token-emit latency ~ 22ms/token, peg-11b-int8 = 18ms/token, peg-11b-int4 = 12ms/token. so peg-11b-int8 wins slightly on steady-state streaming but not a night/day difference.

sanjay: unit-econ framing for GTN leadership:
- if GTN moves 30% of chat traffic from ref-13b-int8 to peg-11b-int8, expected monthly cost reduction ~ 30% * ($105-$78)/$105 ≈ 8.6% of model spend
- if we instead route that 30% to peg-11b-int4 (short-chat only), incremental savings jump to ~ 30% * ($105-$36)/$105 ≈ 20.6% but with risked quality on long prompts

elaine: can we express that as $/MAU or $/1k queries for the GTN deck? they want an easily comparable number.

meera: rough calc: assume avg tokens/query = 120 (chat), 1M queries -> 120M tokens. using ref-13b-int8 at $105/1M tokens -> cost = $12,600. Using peg-11b-int8 -> $9,360 (saves $3,240). Using peg-11b-int4 -> $4,320 (saves $8,280).

ciara: helpful. product will accept peg-11b-int8 for GA if we can show no longform regressions after small quant-fix. what are the mitigations for int4 hallucination/repeat?

meera: mitigation options:
- recalc quantization with per-channel scaling and bias correction (reduces int4 quality gap ~50% in our microbench)
- selective int4: only use int4 for layers L>6 (bottom-end) and keep top layers int8 — hybrid quant profile
- dynamic fallback: detect repeat patterns / low-confidence tokens and transparently re-run on int8 variant for next 128 tokens

dana: ops notes for rollout: canary flags + gradual ramp + automatic rollback threshold on regression metrics. suggested config:
```
routing:
  - route: peg-11b-int8
    pct: 90
    conditions: default
  - route: peg-11b-int4
    pct: 10
    conditions: ctx_len <= 256
canary:
  pct: 5
  monitors: [r_at_1, repeat_rate, latency_p95]
  rollback: repeat_rate_delta > 0.04 or r_at_1_drop > 0.02
```

sanjay: recommendation for GTN PR/hand-off:
- immediate: promote peg-11b-int8 as lower-cost alternative to ref-13b-int8 for chat & longform after small quant correction run (ETA 48h)
- experiments: expose peg-11b-int4 behind opt-in flag for short-chats only and monitor for 2 weeks
- guardrails: auto-fallback to ref-13b-int8 on detected hallucination or repeat patterns; canary rollout with strict rollback rules
- comms: include the $/1M token savings table and the R@5 longform delta in the GTN brief

ciara: sounds good. please add a short FAQ blurb for GTN: "why not roll int4 to everyone" (explain the tradeoff in plain language).

elaine: also add an action item: meera to run per-channel quant fix and produce a 24h re-run report; dana to add canary config to infra; sanjay to draft GTN blurb.

meera: assigning now, will post updated eval (with corrected int4) by 48h. tagging @ciara for product copy review when done. :rocket:

sanjay: thanks team — let's sync after the 48h run. :thumbsup:
